tests.about: The language of each sentence is detected. It must be correct.
tests.note: Sentences with the language they are written in. The first is the default of the notebook: a Chinese proverb. It consists only of characters that are also used in Japanese, so a detector can legitimately be unsure between the two (release 1.2.3 reports zh 0.51 and ja 0.48); for it, Chinese only has to be among the detected languages ("match": "present").
